# The Page

> > The Page connects London homeowners with trusted builders and renovation professionals for kitchens, bathrooms, and home extensions across all London boroughs.

The Page is a contractor matching service specializing in home renovations throughout London, offering expert guides on costs, processes, and real customer stories. Founded to empower homeowners through the renovation journey, the platform provides renovation coaching and connects clients with vetted tradespeople in specific London boroughs including Lambeth, Lewisham, Islington, Hackney, and Wandsworth.

## Key Topics

- Contractor matching services
- Kitchen renovations and remodels
- Bathroom renovations
- Home extensions
- London borough services (Lambeth, Lewisham, Islington, Hackney, Wandsworth, Kensington & Chelsea)
- Renovation costs and budgeting
- Victorian terrace renovations
- Renovation coaching and homeowner advice
- Trustpilot-verified professionals
- Henry Brook (renovation expert and author)
- Customer stories and case studies
- Kitchen fitters and bathroom fitters
- Home improvement planning
- UK construction industry insights
